name: 分辨率一致性
description: 分析 DPI/分辨率 元数据 vs actual pixel dimensions, checks for AI model-specific output sizes, and validates EXIF image size declarations against actual dimensions.
mechanism:
The 分辨率 consistency 分析 examines multiple signals:

1. **AI Model Resolution Matching**: 检查 image dimensions against known AI model outputs (Stable Diffusion: 512², 768², 1024²; DALL-E 3: 1024×1024, 1792×1024; Midjourney: various).

2. **VAE Latent Space Detection**: Validates if dimensions are multiples of 64 (8× downsampled VAE latent space), 其 is characteristic of diffusion models.

3. **DPI Metadata Validation**: Cross-checks declared DPI (72 web, 96 screen, 240/300 print) against actual pixel dimensions. Inconsistencies suggest post-processing.

4. **EXIF Dimension Cross-check**: 比较 ExifImageWidth/ExifImageHeight with actual decoded image dimensions 以检测 resizing.

5. **Megapixel Analysis**: 比较 total pixel count against typical camera sensor outputs vs AI model capabilities.
parameters:
AI model 分辨率s: SD 1.x (512²), SD XL (1024²), DALL-E 3 (1024², 1792×1024), Flux (1024²)
DPI standards: 72 (web), 96 (screen), 240/300 (print)
VAE alignment: multiples of 64
Camera megapixels: 12-108 MP typical
accuracy: 中等 - 70-80%. 对未调整大小的AI输出最有效。图像被调整大小或裁剪后准确度显著下降.
source: Latent Diffusion Model Architecture, JEITA CP-3451C
useCase: Quick AI 检测 screening based on dimensional 分析. Particularly effective for batch processing where images haven't been resized from their original AI生成的 dimensions.
strengths:
• 无需像素处理的快速尺寸分析
• VAE对齐检查对扩散模型高度特异
• DPI不一致揭示后处理
• 检测微妙的调整大小
• 识别特定AI模型输出
limitations:
• 通过调整大小或裁剪轻松绕过
• 相机分辨率与AI输出重叠
• 社交媒体自动调整图像大小
• 放大器改变尺寸
• DPI经常不准确或缺失

references.title: Rombach, R. et al. (2022). High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models.
